Package com.atlan.model.assets

Class SapDatasphereReplicationFlow

java.lang.Object
com.atlan.model.core.AtlanObject
com.atlan.model.relations.Reference
com.atlan.model.assets.Asset
com.atlan.model.assets.SapDatasphereReplicationFlow
All Implemented Interfaces:
IAsset, ICatalog, IFlow, IFlowControlOperation, IReferenceable, ISAP, ISapDatasphereReplicationFlow, AuditDetail, Serializable, Comparable<Reference>
@Generated("com.atlan.generators.ModelGeneratorV2") public class SapDatasphereReplicationFlow extends Asset implements ISapDatasphereReplicationFlow, IFlowControlOperation, ISAP, IFlow, ICatalog, IAsset, IReferenceable
Instance of a SAP Datasphere replication flow in Atlan. A replication flow is a trigger that moves data from sources outside Datasphere (such as S/4HANA, SAP ECC, SAP BW, or S3) into tables created within a Datasphere space, which is modelled as a SQL Schema in Atlan.
